nodes.title: T8 条件节点｜通用模式

widgets_values:
Reference usage:
<Picture 1> is the primary and only reference for the character identity, hairstyle, clothing, facial features, outdoor riverside location, and early-2000s candid travel-photo feeling.
Do not treat the picture as a first frame and last frame pair. Use it as a single-image reference for one continuous short video.

integrated_multimodal_description:

One continuous 5-second highly realistic candid travel shot.

Preserve the same young East Asian woman from <Picture 1>: loose dark hair, white T-shirt, backpack straps, bright natural smile, soft realistic facial features, minimal makeup, and cheerful youthful temperament. Preserve the same outdoor riverside promenade atmosphere with railings, distant skyline, pedestrians, and the casual snapshot feeling of an early-2000s travel memory.

The mood is lively, warm and spontaneous, like a friend is casually filming her during a trip.

0.00-1.20 seconds:
Begin with the girl already leaning slightly toward the camera, smiling brightly. Wind moves her hair naturally across her face. She looks directly into the lens with an open, happy expression, as if reacting to the person filming her.

1.20-2.80 seconds:
She laughs, straightens up a little, and takes one light playful backward step. Her body movement becomes more energetic and cheerful. She lifts one shoulder slightly and swings her arms naturally, keeping the feeling casual rather than posed.

2.80-4.20 seconds:
She does one small happy bounce or light hop in place, then turns her body slightly to one side as if excitedly showing the riverside view behind her. Her smile becomes bigger and more relaxed. Hair and T-shirt move naturally with the motion.

4.20-5.00 seconds:
She turns back toward camera, leans in again with a bright lively smile, and gives a small playful gesture such as a quick wave or a cheerful forward lean, ending on an authentic travel-memory moment.

Camera:
Use a handheld candid travel-video style, as if filmed by a friend. Slight natural shake is allowed. Keep the movement lively but not chaotic. Medium-close framing with a subtle spontaneous feel. No polished commercial camera movement, no dramatic orbit, no heavy cinematic crane motion.

Visual style:
Highly realistic early-2000s Chinese travel snapshot feeling, casual documentary style, natural outdoor light, slightly soft digital-camera texture, mild grain, subtle timestamp-era nostalgia, authentic skin texture, imperfect but charming candid photography feel.

Performance:
Movement should be more dynamic and cheerful than static portrait footage. She should feel genuinely happy, playful, and alive. Expressions should be bright and natural, not exaggerated like a commercial model. All body motion must remain physically believable.

Avoid:
fashion-editorial posing, luxury-commercial polish, stiff movement, plastic skin, over-beautified face, exaggerated slow motion, dramatic cinematic action, distorted hands, excessive motion blur, scene changes, outfit changes, indoor transition, artificial glamour.
